videos.title: Lam Semi 101：先進封裝技術入門
watchFor: 多種晶片整合進同一封裝時，必須管理介面而不只是個別晶片。
精度、均勻性及可擴充性共同影響製程選擇。
可靠度課程需再加入失效與測試證據；此短片不能替代資格驗證。
watchForEn: Integrating different chips requires managing interfaces as well as individual dies.
Precision, uniformity and scalability jointly influence process choice.
Reliability lessons add failure and test evidence; this introduction cannot replace qualification.
videos.scope: 本課「封裝濕氣敏感度分析」的延伸背景。封裝可靠度與共同設計的概念前導；沒有涵蓋所有應力試驗。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Package moisture-sensitivity analysis. Conceptual preparation for package reliability and co-design; it does not cover every stress test. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「辨識吸濕材料」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Identify moisture-absorbing materials requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「區分爆米花與腐蝕」列為查證任務：觀察焦點：列出能辨別兩者的影像及電性證據。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Separate popcorning and corrosion: Observation focus: List imaging and electrical evidence distinguishing them. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
videos.rights: Official external player/link only. Copyright remains with the publisher. No download, clipping, transcript or rehosting license is claimed.

courses.overview: 相似工法的重點是可轉移的物理與證據；下列比較保留各自不同的材料和模型邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Related methods share transferable physics and evidence while retaining distinct materials and model boundaries.

related.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度
related.why: 水分前處理影響熱循環結果
related.transfer: 水分前處理影響熱循環結果
related.difference: 濕熱與乾熱需分開判定主因
related.differenceEn: Damp and dry heat need separate causal analysis
practice: 畫出「封裝濕氣敏感度分析」與「封裝溫度循環可靠度」的材料、能量或資料交接。
以「辨識吸濕材料」為比較起點，指出兩課共享的守恆或量測原理。
提出一個會使「水分前處理影響熱循環結果」失效的邊界條件，並安排驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the material, energy or data handoff between Package moisture-sensitivity analysis and Package thermal-cycling reliability.
Use identify moisture-absorbing materials to identify a shared conservation or measurement principle.
State and test one boundary that would invalidate this transfer: Moisture preconditioning affects thermal cycling

courses.summary: 本課以水分擴散、界面剝離與回焊蒸汽壓連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through moisture diffusion, delamination and reflow vapor pressure. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.title: 合作研究中心在魯汶成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center starts in Leuven
history.text: imec 官方歷史記錄其成立背景；共同研究模式使材料、元件和系統問題能在同一研究環境連結。
history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

courses.connection: 將地圖視為研究交流的定位點，再依每個來源了解不同機構在材料、設備、量測與系統驗證上的分工。
courses.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.
